item.tib: bcom ldan 'das dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga
item.coloph: bcom ldan 'das dpal bde mchog 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga slob dpon nag po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa yin no/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po d+harma shrI b+hA dra dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsA ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur ba/ slad nas paN+Di ta su ma ti kIrti'i zhal snga nas/ bod kyi lo tsA ba aR+Ya mar pa chos kyi dbang phyug gis zhu chen bgyis pa//
